text:
maria: Quick RN draft ready for Friday's deploy window. Need internal announce copy + pin checklist. TL;DR: backend batching perf tuning and a small runtime bump.

deploy-bot: auto-check -> change window Fri 22:00 UTC, duration ~90m. Canary + staged rollout supported. Job queued: #deploy-892.

sam: shared canary plan at https://gist.github.com/xx/canary-plan — 5%->25%->100% over ~30m steps, health checks: latency, 5xx errs, token-cost spike. If 3 consecutive failing checks -> abort/rollback.

ops-jay: Quick ask re rollback criteria: propose rollback triggers: 99p latency > 350ms OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m. Also require model pin fallback to prior stable version.

alexa: I can draft internal announce. Short, punchy. Will post draft to #internal-announce for review.

maria: RN snippet for internal copy below — please eyeball and :thumbsup: if good.

```
Internal: Friday 22:00 UTC — runtime + batching tuning
What changes: backend inference runtime bump (2.4.0) and model weight layout changes to improve batching throughput.
Impact: expected 10–25% lower token cost and similar latency in steady-state. Canary rollout planned; brief risk of transient latency during warmup.
Rollback: automatic on defined health triggers; manual abort allowed. Oncall: @ops-jay. Support contact: support@redwood.ai
Pin targets: model v1.8.2, runtime 2.4.0
```

sam: lgtm. Add note about metrics lookback window (use 1m and 5m). Also call out cost-monitoring alert.

ops-jay: ops ✅. I'll run the pin verification at T-30m and confirm readiness. @deploy-bot will only proceed once I ack. Manual abort path: `/deploy abort 892` or rollback job `/deploy rollback 892`.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: deploy-892 created by maria. Canary schedule: 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (20m). Health checks every 30s. Abort command: `/deploy abort 892`.

alexa: Posted announcement draft in #internal-announce and tagged SRE, Support, and Platform. Copy below (short):

"Friday 22:00 UTC: performance tuning deploy. Canary rollout, minimal customer impact expected. Ops on standby: @ops-jay. See RN for details."

sam: quick config Q — do we enable quantization flag for this release? I left a small config diff in the gist.

ops-jay: If quantization is enabled, we should add fast fallback to non-quantized model for the first 2m of canary. I'll add that as an automated policy.

maria: sounds good. Final ask: when you all :thumbsup: I'll mark RN final and coordinate the email blast. ops, ping me once pin check passes.

sam: :thumbsup:

ops-jay: :thumbsup: pin check scheduled at T-30m

alexa: :thumbsup: announcing in 10m after copy approvals

deploy-bot: Note: If rollback triggered, job will revert traffic and create incident stub in #incidents."
